confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Hong Kong price levels for July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals, cocktail, wine) are moderately reliable. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because Hong Kong accommodation rates vary widely by district, season and booking lead time. The FX value was taken from search-result summaries of RBA exchange-rate pages; the F11.1 table itself was not loaded directly. Cocktail and wine were estimated from the local beer price relationship, since direct knowledge of those prices is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis is East Asia, benchmarked against Singapore for mid-range dining and 3-star hotel levels and against Hong Kong's dense budget guesthouse and hostel market for the lower accommodation tiers.
